+				Exit Sub
+			Elseif nShot = 0 Then
+				ML(4,6,0) = 2
+			Elseif nShot = 6 Then
+				ML(4,0,0) = 2
+			End If
+
+		Case 5
+
+			if ML(5,1,1) >= ModeReq(5,1) AND ML(5,5,1) >= ModeReq(5,5) Then
+				WinMode
+				Exit Sub
+			Elseif nShot = 1 Then
+				ML(5,5,0) = 2
+			Elseif nShot = 5 Then
+				ML(5,1,0) = 2
+			End If
+		Case 6

+			Elseif nShot = 3 Then
+				ML(6,4,0) = 2
+			Elseif nShot = 4 Then
+				ML(6,0,0) = 2
+			Elseif nShot = 0 Then
+				ML(6,5,0) = 2

+Sub ResetSewerTime
+	if bMidnightMadnessMode Then Exit Sub
+	SewerCountDown = nSewerTime(CurrentPlayer)
+
+	If SewerCountDown > 239 Then
+		nSewerMin = 4
+		nSewerSec = SewerCountDown mod 60
+	Elseif SewerCountDown > 179 Then 
+		nSewerMin = 3
+		nSewerSec = SewerCountDown mod 60
+	Elseif SewerCountDown > 119 Then 
+		nSewerMin = 2
+		nSewerSec = SewerCountDown mod 60
+	Elseif SewerCountDown > 59 Then 
+		nSewerMin = 1
+		nSewerSec = SewerCountDown mod 60
+	Else
+		nSewerMin = ""
+		nSewerSec = SewerCountDown mod 60
+	End If
+
+	DisplaySewerTime

+
+    Elseif bEggShenMagic Then

+
+	Elseif bBPFlipperActive Then
+		FindCurrentMode = "Sewer"	
+
+	Elseif nSuperSpinnerMode = 2 Then
+		FindCurrentMode = "SuperSpinners"	
+
+	Elseif nWildmanBashMode = 2 Then
+		FindCurrentMode = "Wildman"
+
+	Elseif LopanActive = 1 Then
+		FindCurrentMode = "MiaoYinMB"	
+
+	Elseif nMiniWizard(Currentplayer,0) <> 0 Then

+			Case 1

+				FindCurrentMode = "Thunder"
+			Case 3

+			Case 4
+				FindCurrentMode = "Lopan"

+	Elseif Mode(CurrentPlayer,0) <> 0 Then

+			Case 1
+				FindCurrentMode = "Mode1"

+				FindCurrentMode = "Mode2"

+Const LoPan_StartY    = 310.2
+Const LoPan_EndY      = 664
+Const LoPan_TotalHits = 5
+
+Dim LoPan_StepY
+
+
+' Steps
+LoPan_StepY = (LoPan_EndY - LoPan_StartY) / LoPan_TotalHits
+
+Sub LoPan_Advance()
+    If nCaptiveBallHits(CurrentPlayer) > LoPan_TotalHits Then Exit Sub
+
+    ' First advance only â†’ open door
+    If nCaptiveBallHits(CurrentPlayer) = 1 Then
+        LoPanDoor_OpenTemp
+    End If
+
+    lopan001.Y = lopan001.Y + LoPan_StepY
+
+    ' Safe
+    If lopan001.Y > LoPan_EndY Then lopan001.Y = LoPan_EndY
+
+ '   Debug.Print "LoPan Advance: " & lopan001.Y
+End Sub

+Sub DuckUpdate
+	Dim fGoalVolume
+
+	If (Not bDuck) And sMusicTrack <> "" Then
+		If sMusicTrack = "music-attract" then
+			fGoalVolume = fAttractVolume
+		Else
+			fGoalVolume = fMusicVolume
+		end If
+
+		If fCurrentMusicVol < fGoalVolume Then
+			' fade in is 6 updates of 17 ms
+			fCurrentMusicVol = fCurrentMusicVol + ((fGoalVolume - fDuckfactor) / 6)
+
+			If fCurrentMusicVol >= fGoalVolume Then
+				fCurrentMusicVol = fGoalVolume
+			End If
+			PlaySound sMusicTrack, -1, fCurrentMusicVol,0,0,0,1,0,0
+		End If
+	End If

+Const LightningFollowerCount = 9

+Const LightningFrameEnd   = 15    ' last usable frame (LB_15)
+Const LightningZOffset    = 0
+Const LightningXOffset    = 0

+'--------------------------------------------------------
+' Initialize system (call once in Table_Init)
+'--------------------------------------------------------
+Sub InitLightningFollowers()
+    Dim i, frameNum, idx
+
+    ReDim LightningFollowers(LightningFollowerCount)
+    ReDim LightningFrames(0)
+    ReDim LastX(LightningFollowerCount)
+    ReDim LastY(LightningFollowerCount)
+
+    For i = 1 To LightningFollowerCount
+        On Error Resume Next
+        Set LightningFollowers(i) = Eval("LightningFollower" & i)
+        On Error GoTo 0
+        If Not LightningFollowers(i) Is Nothing Then
+            LightningFollowers(i).Visible = False
+            LightningFollowers(i).IntensityScale = 0
+            LastX(i) = 0
+            LastY(i) = 0
+        End If
+    Next
+
+    ' Build frame list (LB_1 â†’ LB_15)
+    idx = 0
+    For frameNum = LightningFrameStart To LightningFrameEnd
+        ReDim Preserve LightningFrames(idx)
+        LightningFrames(idx) = "LB_" & frameNum
+        idx = idx + 1
+    Next
+    TotalLightningFrames = idx
+
+    ' Ensure editor timer exists and is configured
+    tFlameFollow.Interval = 5
+    tFlameFollow.Enabled = False
+
+    LightningActive = False
+End Sub

+Sub StopLightningFollowers()
+    Dim i

+    tFlameFollow.Enabled = False

+        End If

+'--------------------------------------------------------
+' Timer updates animation, rotation + ball tracking
+'--------------------------------------------------------
+Sub tFlameFollow_Timer()
+    On Error Resume Next
+    If Not LightningActive Then Exit Sub
+
+    ' Advance animation frame
+    If TotalLightningFrames > 0 Then
+        LightningAnimPos = (LightningAnimPos + 1) Mod TotalLightningFrames
+    End If
+
+    Dim b, i, dx, dy, angRad, angDeg
+    i = 1
+
+    For Each b In GetBalls()
+        If Not b Is Nothing Then
+            ' only for rolling balls (avoid captive)
+            If b.Z < 40 Then
+                If i <= LightningFollowerCount Then
+                    If Not LightningFollowers(i) Is Nothing Then
+                        dx = b.X - LastX(i)
+                        dy = b.Y - LastY(i)
+
+                        If Abs(dx) + Abs(dy) > 0.5 Then
+                            angRad = Atan2(dy, dx)
+                            angDeg = angRad * 57.2957795130823
+                            LightningFollowers(i).RotZ = angDeg + 270
+                        Else
+                            LightningFollowers(i).RotZ = 0
+                        End If
+
+                        LastX(i) = b.X
+                        LastY(i) = b.Y
+
+                        ' dynamic trail distance by speed
+                        Dim speed, trailDist
+                        speed = Sqr((dx * dx) + (dy * dy))
+                        trailDist = -75 - (speed * 0.4)
+
+                        ' clamp trail
+                        If trailDist < -80 Then trailDist = -80
+                        If trailDist > -10 Then trailDist = -10
+
+                        With LightningFollowers(i)
+                            .Visible = True
+                            .X = b.X
+                            .Y = b.Y
+                            .Z = b.Z + LightningZOffset
+                            .ImageA = LightningFrames(LightningAnimPos)
+                            .IntensityScale = 1
+                        End With
+                    End If
+                    i = i + 1
+                End If
+            End If
+        End If
+    Next
+
+    ' Hide any unused followers
+    For i = i To LightningFollowerCount
+        If Not LightningFollowers(i) Is Nothing Then LightningFollowers(i).Visible = False
+    Next
+
+    On Error GoTo 0
+End Sub

+' GUARDIAN FLYING
+'====================================================
+
+'-------------------------
+' CONFIG
+'-------------------------
+
+Const GuardHomeX = 497.1737
+Const GuardHomeY = 155.8722
+Const GuardHomeZ = 130
+
+Const GuardDepartX = 442.8601
+Const GuardDepartY = 1429.434
+Const GuardDepartZ = 90
+
+Const GuardDoorOpenRotX = 110
+Const GuardDoorClosedRotX = 0
+
+' pause tuning
+Const GuardPauseChance = 0.015
+Const GuardPauseHoldMin = 600
+Const GuardPauseHoldMax = 1400
+
+Const GuardBaseSpeed = 0.035
+Const GuardSpeedEase = 0.06
+
+'-------------------------
+' STATE
+'-------------------------
+
+Dim GuardAngle
+Dim GuardOrbitRadius
+Dim GuardReturning
+Dim GuardDeparting
+Dim GuardPrevX, GuardPrevY
+Dim GuardDelayActive
+
+Dim GuardPaused
+Dim GuardPauseTime
+Dim GuardSpeed
+Dim GuardTargetSpeed
+
+'====================================================
+' CALLS
+'====================================================
+
+Sub GuardSequence_Start()
+
+    guard.X = GuardHomeX
+    guard.Y = GuardHomeY
+    guard.Z = GuardHomeZ
+    guard.Visible = True
+
+    GuardPrevX = guard.X
+    GuardPrevY = guard.Y
+
+    GuardAngle = 0
+    GuardOrbitRadius = 0
+    GuardReturning = False
+    GuardDeparting = True
+    GuardPaused = False
+
+    GuardSpeed = GuardBaseSpeed
+    GuardTargetSpeed = GuardBaseSpeed
+
+    guarddoor001.RotX = GuardDoorClosedRotX
+

+

+' DELAY TIMER
+'====================================================
+
+Sub GuardDelayTimer_Timer()
+

+'====================================================
+' GUARD FLY TIMER
+'====================================================
+
+Sub GuardFlyTimer_Timer()
+
+    Dim dx, dy
+
+    '---------------------------------
+    ' SMOOTH SLOW DOWN
+    '---------------------------------
+    GuardSpeed = GuardSpeed + (GuardTargetSpeed - GuardSpeed) * GuardSpeedEase
+
+    '---------------------------------
+    ' DEPARTING
+    '---------------------------------
+    If GuardDeparting And Not GuardReturning Then
+
+        guard.X = guard.X + (GuardDepartX - guard.X) * 0.08
+        guard.Y = guard.Y + (GuardDepartY - guard.Y) * 0.08
+        guard.Z = guard.Z + (GuardDepartZ - guard.Z) * 0.08
+
+        If Abs(guard.X - GuardDepartX) < 2 _
+        And Abs(guard.Y - GuardDepartY) < 2 _
+        And Abs(guard.Z - GuardDepartZ) < 2 Then
+
+            guard.X = GuardDepartX
+            guard.Y = GuardDepartY
+            guard.Z = GuardDepartZ
+
+            GuardDeparting = False
+            GuardAngle = 0
+            GuardOrbitRadius = 0
+        End If
+
+    '---------------------------------
+    ' ORBITING
+    '---------------------------------
+    ElseIf Not GuardReturning Then
+
+        ' pause logic
+        If GuardOrbitRadius >= 1 Then
+            If GuardTargetSpeed = GuardBaseSpeed Then
+                If Rnd < GuardPauseChance Then
+                    GuardTargetSpeed = 0
+                    GuardPauseTime = GuardPauseHoldMin + Rnd * (GuardPauseHoldMax - GuardPauseHoldMin)
+                End If
+            Else
+                GuardPauseTime = GuardPauseTime - GuardFlyTimer.Interval
+                If GuardPauseTime <= 0 Then
+                    GuardTargetSpeed = GuardBaseSpeed
+                End If
+            End If
+        End If
+
+        GuardAngle = GuardAngle + GuardSpeed
+
+        If GuardOrbitRadius < 1 Then
+            GuardOrbitRadius = GuardOrbitRadius + 0.03
+            If GuardOrbitRadius > 1 Then GuardOrbitRadius = 1
+        End If
+
+        guard.X = GuardDepartX + Cos(GuardAngle) * 260 * GuardOrbitRadius
+        guard.Y = GuardDepartY + Sin(GuardAngle * 0.8) * 200 * GuardOrbitRadius
+        guard.Z = GuardDepartZ + Sin(GuardAngle * 1.4) * 18
+
+    '---------------------------------
+    ' RETURN HOME
+    '---------------------------------
+    Else
+
+        guard.X = guard.X * 0.85 + GuardHomeX * 0.15
+        guard.Y = guard.Y * 0.85 + GuardHomeY * 0.15
+        guard.Z = guard.Z * 0.85 + GuardHomeZ * 0.15
+
+        If Abs(guard.X - GuardHomeX) < 2 _
+        And Abs(guard.Y - GuardHomeY) < 2 _
+        And Abs(guard.Z - GuardHomeZ) < 2 Then
+
+            guard.X = GuardHomeX
+            guard.Y = GuardHomeY
+            guard.Z = GuardHomeZ
+
+            guarddoor001.RotX = GuardDoorClosedRotX
+            guard.Visible = False
+            GuardFlyTimer.Enabled = False
+        End If
+
+    End If
+
+    '---------------------------------
+    ' FACE DIRECTION
+    '---------------------------------
+    dx = guard.X - GuardPrevX
+    dy = guard.Y - GuardPrevY
+
+    If Abs(dx) > 0.01 Or Abs(dy) > 0.01 Then
+        guard.RotZ = Atn2(dy, dx) * 57.2958
+    End If
+
+    GuardPrevX = guard.X
+    GuardPrevY = guard.Y
+
+End Sub

+Const SorcererStartZ = -200

+' TEMP SWAP 001 â†’ 002 FOR 2 SECONDS

+
+    sorcerer001.Visible = False
+    sorcerer002.Visible = True
+

+

+'===========================================
+' MODE END HIDE EVERYTHING
+'===========================================
+Sub EndSorcererMode()
+
+    SorcererTimer.Enabled = False
+    SwapBackTimer.Enabled = False
+    SorcererRunning = False
+
+    sorcerer001.Visible = False
+    sorcerer002.Visible = False
+    sorcerer003.Visible = False
+    lopan001.Visible    = True
+    
+     ' RESET LOPAN POSITION
+    LoPan_Reset
+End Sub
+
+
+'===========================================
+' MAIN TIMER
+'===========================================
+Sub SorcererTimer_Timer()
+
+    '========================
+    ' RISE PHASE (003 ONLY)
+    '========================
+    If Not SorcererAtTop Then
+        sorcerer003.Z = sorcerer003.Z + SorcererZStep
+
+        If sorcerer003.Z >= SorcererEndZ Then
+            sorcerer003.Z = SorcererEndZ
+            SorcererAtTop = True
+        End If
+
+        Exit Sub
+    End If
+
+    '========================
+    ' FADE PHASE (003 + LOPAN)
+    '========================
+    SorcererFadeCount = SorcererFadeCount + 1
+
+    ' 003 fades out
+    sorcerer003.Visible = (SorcererFadeCount Mod 2 = 0)
+
+    ' Lopan fades opposite
+    lopan001.Visible = Not sorcerer003.Visible
+
+    If SorcererFadeCount >= FadePulses Then
+        sorcerer003.Visible = False
+        lopan001.Visible    = False
+
+        SorcererTimer.Enabled = False
+        SorcererRunning = False
+
+        ' Reveal 001
+        sorcerer001.Visible = True
+    End If
+
+End Sub

+Sub LopanChase
+	LopanChaseTimer.Enabled = False
+	LopanChaseTimer.Enabled = True
+	if nLastLopanPos <> 0 Then StopLopanAnimation (nLastLopanPos)
+	if nLastLopanPos <> 0 Then 
+		nNewLopanPos = rndNumNot(1,5,nLastLopanPos)
+	Else
+		nNewLopanPos = RndNbr(5)
+	End IF
+
+	nLastLopanPos = nNewLopanPos
+
+	Debug.print "NewLopan: " & nNewLopanPos
+
+
+	Select Case nNewLopanPos
+		Case 1
+			BallHandlingQueue.Add "Pan1ModeStart","Pan1ModeStart",24,2000,0,0,0,False	
+		Case 2
+			BallHandlingQueue.Add "Pan2ModeStart","Pan2ModeStart",24,2000,0,0,0,False

+			BallHandlingQueue.Add "Pan3ModeStart","Pan3ModeStart",24,2000,0,0,0,False	
+		Case 4
+			BallHandlingQueue.Add "Pan4ModeStart","Pan4ModeStart",24,2000,0,0,0,False

+Const LM_TOTAL_FRAMES = 15
+
+Dim LMFrames, SJFrames
+Dim Flashers, FlashPos, FlashRunning, FlashType
+Dim FlashDelay
+Dim GlobalSpeed
+
+' FlashType:
+' 0 = LM
+' 1 = LMM
+' 2 = JACKPOT
+
+Sub InitFlashers()
+
+    Dim i
+
+    GlobalSpeed = 2
+
+    ReDim LMFrames(LM_TOTAL_FRAMES)
+    For i = 1 To LM_TOTAL_FRAMES
+        LMFrames(i) = "LM_" & i
+    Next
+
+    ReDim SJFrames(45)
+    For i = 1 To 45
+        SJFrames(i) = "SJ_" & i
+    Next
+
+    Flashers = Array( _
+        LM1, LM2, LM3, LM4, LM5, _
+        LMM1, LMM2, LMM3, LMM4, LMM5, _
+        LPSJackpot _
+    )
+
+    ReDim FlashPos(UBound(Flashers))
+    ReDim FlashRunning(UBound(Flashers))
+    ReDim FlashType(UBound(Flashers))
+    ReDim FlashDelay(UBound(Flashers))
+
+End Sub

+'========================================
+' START FUNCTIONS
+'========================================
+
+Sub StartLM(index)
+
+    PlaySound "LopM_hit"
+
+    FlashRunning(index) = True
+    FlashPos(index) = 1
+    FlashType(index) = 0
+    FlashDelay(index) = GlobalSpeed
+
+    Flashers(index).Visible = True
+    Flashers(index).ImageA = LMFrames(1)
+
+End Sub
+
+Sub StartLMM(index)
+
+    PlaySound "LMM_Hit"
+
+    FlashRunning(index) = True
+    FlashPos(index) = 1 ' maps to SJ_2
+    FlashType(index) = 1
+    FlashDelay(index) = 0
+
+    Flashers(index).Visible = True
+    Flashers(index).ImageA = SJFrames(2) ' âœ… FIX START BLANK
+
+End Sub
+
+Sub StartLPSJackpot()
+
+    Dim i
+    i = 10
+
+    PlaySound "LPSJackpot"
+
+    FlashRunning(i) = True
+    FlashPos(i) = 1
+    FlashType(i) = 2
+    FlashDelay(i) = 0
+
+    Flashers(i).Visible = True
+    Flashers(i).ImageA = SJFrames(2)
+
+End Sub
+
+'========================================
+' TIMER
+'========================================
+
+Sub FlasherTimer_Timer()
+
+    Dim i
+
+    For i = 0 To UBound(Flashers)
+
+        If FlashRunning(i) Then
+
+            FlashDelay(i) = FlashDelay(i) + 1
+
+            If FlashDelay(i) >= GlobalSpeed Then
+
+                FlashDelay(i) = 0
+
+                Select Case FlashType(i)
+
+                    '========================
+                    ' LM
+                    '========================
+                    Case 0
+                        If FlashPos(i) <= LM_TOTAL_FRAMES Then
+                            Flashers(i).ImageA = LMFrames(FlashPos(i))
+                        End If
+
+                        FlashPos(i) = FlashPos(i) + 1
+
+                        If FlashPos(i) > LM_TOTAL_FRAMES Then
+                            Flashers(i).Visible = False
+                            FlashRunning(i) = False
+                        End If
+
+                    '========================
+                    ' LMM (SJ_2 â†’ SJ_42 ONLY)
+                    '========================
+                    Case 1
+                        If FlashPos(i) <= 41 Then ' 2 â†’ 42
+                            Flashers(i).ImageA = SJFrames(FlashPos(i) + 1)
+                        End If
+
+                        FlashPos(i) = FlashPos(i) + 1
+
+                        If FlashPos(i) > 41 Then
+                            Flashers(i).Visible = False
+                            FlashRunning(i) = False
+                        End If
+
+                    '========================
+                    ' JACKPOT (same range)
+                    '========================
+                    Case 2
+                        If FlashPos(i) <= 41 Then
+                            Flashers(i).ImageA = SJFrames(FlashPos(i) + 1)
+                        End If
+
+                        FlashPos(i) = FlashPos(i) + 1
+
+                        If FlashPos(i) > 41 Then
+                            Flashers(i).Visible = False
+                            FlashRunning(i) = False
+                        End If
+
+                End Select
+
+            End If
+
+        End If
+
+    Next
+
+End Sub

+'=============================
+' BEACON STACK
+'=============================
+
+Dim BeaconStack(10)
+Dim BeaconStackTop
+
+BeaconStackTop = -1
+
+Sub BeaconPush(mode)
+    BeaconStackTop = BeaconStackTop + 1
+    BeaconStack(BeaconStackTop) = mode
+    BeaconMode = mode
+End Sub
+
+Sub BeaconPop()
+
+    If BeaconStackTop >= 0 Then
+        BeaconStackTop = BeaconStackTop - 1
+    End If
+
+    If BeaconStackTop >= 0 Then
+        BeaconMode = BeaconStack(BeaconStackTop)
+    Else
+        StopBeacon
+    End If
+
+End Sub
+
+Sub BeaconClearStack()
+    BeaconStackTop = -1
+End Sub

+'=============================
+' MAIN TIMER
+'=============================
+
+Sub BeaconTimer_Timer()
+	if nPCMod = 0 Then BeaconTimer.Enabled = 0 : Exit Sub
+    Select Case BeaconMode
+    
+        Case 0
+            BeaconCurrentSpeed = BeaconBaseSpeed
+            Beacon1.IntensityScale = 1
+        
+        Case 1
+        
+            BeaconSpeedRamp = BeaconSpeedRamp + 1
+            
+            If BeaconSpeedRamp < 40 Then
+                BeaconCurrentSpeed = 2 + (BeaconSpeedRamp / 3)
+            ElseIf BeaconSpeedRamp < 80 Then
+                BeaconCurrentSpeed = 18 - (BeaconSpeedRamp / 3)
+            Else
+                BeaconSpeedRamp = 0
+            End If
+            
+            Beacon1.IntensityScale = 1
+        
+        Case 2
+        
+            BeaconCurrentSpeed = BeaconBaseSpeed
+            
+            If BeaconBlinkState = 1 Then
+                Beacon1.IntensityScale = Beacon1.IntensityScale - 0.08
+                If Beacon1.IntensityScale <= 0 Then
+                    Beacon1.IntensityScale = 0
+                    BeaconBlinkState = -1
+                End If
+            Else
+                Beacon1.IntensityScale = Beacon1.IntensityScale + 0.08
+                If Beacon1.IntensityScale >= 1 Then
+                    Beacon1.IntensityScale = 1
+                    BeaconBlinkState = 1
+                End If
+            End If
+
+        Case 3
+        
+            BeaconCurrentSpeed = 30
+            
+            BeaconSpinCount = BeaconSpinCount + BeaconCurrentSpeed
+            
+            If BeaconSpinCount >= 360 Then
+                BeaconPop
+                Exit Sub
+            End If
+
+        '========================================
+        ' MODE 4 - STROBE SPIN
+        '========================================
+        Case 4
+
+            BeaconCurrentSpeed = 25
+
+            If BeaconBlinkState = 1 Then
+                Beacon1.IntensityScale = 1
+                BeaconBlinkState = -1
+            Else
+                Beacon1.IntensityScale = 0
+                BeaconBlinkState = 1
+            End If
+
+
+        '========================================
+        ' MODE 7 - RAINBOW SPIN
+        '========================================
+        Case 7
+
+            BeaconCurrentSpeed = BeaconBaseSpeed
+
+            sRed = (sRed + 5) Mod 255
+
+            Beacon1.Color = RGB( _
+                128 + 127 * Sin(sRed * 0.05), _
+                128 + 127 * Sin((sRed + 85) * 0.05), _
+                128 + 127 * Sin((sRed + 170) * 0.05))
+
+            Beacon1.IntensityScale = 1
+
+
+        '========================================
+        ' MODE 8 - PURPLE STROBE
+        '========================================
+        Case 8
+
+            BeaconCurrentSpeed = 25
+            BeaconPurpleStrobeTimer = BeaconPurpleStrobeTimer + 1
+
+            If BeaconBlinkState = 1 Then
+                Beacon1.IntensityScale = 1
+                BeaconBlinkState = -1
+            Else
+                Beacon1.IntensityScale = 0
+                BeaconBlinkState = 1
+            End If
+
+            Beacon1.Color = RGB(180,0,255)
+
+            If BeaconPurpleStrobeTimer > 20 Then
+                BeaconPop
+                Exit Sub
+            End If
+
+
+        '========================================
+        ' MODE 9 - RED STROBE
+        '========================================
+        Case 9
+
+            BeaconCurrentSpeed = 25
+            BeaconPurpleStrobeTimer = BeaconPurpleStrobeTimer + 1
+
+            If BeaconBlinkState = 1 Then
+                Beacon1.IntensityScale = 1
+                BeaconBlinkState = -1
+            Else
+                Beacon1.IntensityScale = 0
+                BeaconBlinkState = 1
+            End If
+
+            Beacon1.Color = RGB(255,0,0)
+
+            If BeaconPurpleStrobeTimer > 20 Then
+                BeaconPop
+                Exit Sub
+            End If
+
+    End Select
+
+
+    BeaconAngle = (BeaconAngle + BeaconCurrentSpeed) Mod 360
+    
+    Beacon.RotZ = BeaconAngle
+    Beacon1.RotZ = BeaconAngle
+
+
+    If BeaconMode = 2 Then
+        
+        Select Case BeaconBlinkColorMode
+        
+            Case 1
+                Beacon1.Color = RGB(255, sRed / 3, 0)
+            
+            Case 2
+                Beacon1.Color = RGB(255,191,0) 
+            
+            Case 3
+                Beacon1.Color = RGB(0, sRed, 255)
+            
+            Case 4
+                Beacon1.Color = RGB(0, 255, sRed)
+
+            Case 5
+                Beacon1.Color = RGB(180,0,255)
+            
+            Case Else
+                Beacon1.Color = RGB(sRed,255,0)
+        
+        End Select
+
+    ElseIf BeaconMode = 3 Then
+        
+        Beacon1.Color = RGB(BeaconTripleR,BeaconTripleG,BeaconTripleB)
+
+    ElseIf BeaconMode <> 7 And BeaconMode <> 8 And BeaconMode <> 9 Then
+        
+        Beacon1.Color = RGB(sRed,255,0)
+
+    End If
+
+
+    FlasherbloomCenter001.IntensityScale = Beacon1.IntensityScale
+    FlasherbloomCenter001.Color = Beacon1.Color
+
+End Sub

+'*******************************************
+'  ZINS: Instruction Mode
+'*******************************************
+'===============================
+' Instruction Mode 
+'===============================
+Dim gInstructionMode : gInstructionMode = False
+
+' --- Light state stores for snapshot/restore ---
+Dim gSavedInserts : Set gSavedInserts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
+Dim gSavedGI      : Set gSavedGI      = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
+
+' --- Lookups by name (Light objects) ---
+Dim gInsertLookup : Set gInsertLookup = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ' inserts only
+Dim gGILookup     : Set gGILookup     = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ' GI only
+
+' --- Active feature state ---
+Dim gFeatureKeys          ' ordered array of feature keys
+Dim gFeatureIndex           ' current feature index
+Dim gSeqSteps               ' current feature's steps array
+Dim gSeqStepIdx             ' index within steps
+Dim gBlinkState : gBlinkState = True
+Dim gBlinkGroup : Set gBlinkGroup = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ' lights that blink this step
+Dim gGIOn       : Set gGIOn       = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ' GI lights currently left on
+Dim gActiveFlasherName       ' string name of flasher for current feature
+
+' --- Timers ---
+' gBlinkTimer.Enabled=False, Interval ~ 150
+' gInstrSeqTimer.Enabled=False, Interval ~ 250
+
+'========================
+'  Initialization helpers
+'========================
+Sub BuildInsertLookup()
+    Dim L
+    gInsertLookup.RemoveAll
+    For Each L In cInserts                 ' uses your existing table collection to discover inserts
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then Set gInsertLookup(L.Name) = L
+    Next
+End Sub
+
+Sub BuildGILookup()
+    Dim L
+    gGILookup.RemoveAll
+    For Each L In cGI                      ' uses your existing table collection to discover GI
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then Set gGILookup(L.Name) = L
+    Next
+End Sub
+
+'========================
+'  Snapshot / Restore PF
+'========================
+Sub Instr_SnapshotLights()
+    Dim L
+    gSavedInserts.RemoveAll
+    For Each L In cInserts
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+            gSavedInserts(L.Name) = Array(L.State, L.IntensityScale)
+        End If
+    Next
+
+    gSavedGI.RemoveAll
+    For Each L In cGI
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+            gSavedGI(L.Name) = Array(L.State, L.IntensityScale)
+        End If
+    Next
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_AllInsertsOff()
+    Dim L
+    For Each L In cInserts
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+            L.State = 0 : L.IntensityScale = 0
+        End If
+    Next
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_AllGIOff()
+    Dim L
+    For Each L In cGI
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+            L.State = 0 : L.IntensityScale = 0
+        End If
+    Next
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_AllLightsOff()
+    Instr_AllInsertsOff
+    Instr_AllGIOff
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_RestoreLights()
+    Dim L, s
+    For Each L In cInserts
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+            If gSavedInserts.Exists(L.Name) Then
+                s = gSavedInserts(L.Name)
+                L.State = s(0)
+                L.IntensityScale = s(1)
+            End If
+        End If
+    Next
+
+    For Each L In cGI
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+            If gSavedGI.Exists(L.Name) Then
+                s = gSavedGI(L.Name)
+                L.State = s(0)
+                L.IntensityScale = s(1)
+            End If
+        End If
+    Next
+End Sub
+
+'========================
+'  Begin / End Mode
+'========================
+Sub BeginInstructionMode()
+    If gInstructionMode  Then Exit Sub
+    If (ballsonplayfield < 2 AND bBallInPlungerLane = True) OR bAttractMode Then 
+
+		if bAttractMode Then bReturnAttractMode = True: StopAttractMode
+
+		gInstructionMode = True
+
+	'    ' Pause the ROM
+	'    On Error Resume Next : Controller.Pause = True : On Error GoTo 0
+
+		BuildInsertLookup
+		BuildGILookup
+		Instr_DefineFeatures
+		Instr_DefineContent
+
+		Instr_SnapshotLights
+		Instr_AllLightsOff
+
+		gFeatureIndex = 0
+		Instr_ShowFeatureByIndex gFeatureIndex
+	End If
+End Sub
+
+Sub EndInstructionMode()
+debug.print "END : Hiding Instruction Cards"
+    If Not gInstructionMode Then Exit Sub
+	ReturnState
+	ReturnJackTargets
+	EndBashMode
+	gInstructionMode = False
+	StopBeacon
+
+	'BallHandlingQueue.Add "gInstructionMode = False","gInstructionMode = False",20,250,0,0,0,False
+    
+
+    gBlinkTimer.Enabled = False
+    gInstrSeqTimer.Enabled = False
+
+    Instr_HideAllFlashers
+    Instr_TurnOffGIActive
+
+    Instr_RestoreLights
+
+   ' On Error Resume Next : Controller.Pause = False : On Error GoTo 0
+
+    gSavedInserts.RemoveAll
+    gSavedGI.RemoveAll
+
+
+	if bReturnAttractMode Then bReturnAttractMode = False : StartAttractMode
+
+	BallHandlingQueue.Add "ReturnState","ReturnState",20,250,0,0,0,False
+End Sub

+'========================
+'  Feature switching
+'========================
+Sub Instr_NextFeature()
+    If Not gInstructionMode Then Exit Sub
+	ReturnState
+    gFeatureIndex = (gFeatureIndex + 1) Mod (UBound(gFeatureKeys) + 1)
+    Instr_ShowFeatureByIndex gFeatureIndex
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_PrevFeature()
+    If Not gInstructionMode Then Exit Sub
+	ReturnState
+    Dim n : n = UBound(gFeatureKeys) + 1
+    gFeatureIndex = (gFeatureIndex - 1 + n) Mod n
+    Instr_ShowFeatureByIndex gFeatureIndex
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_ShowFeatureByIndex(idx)
+    Dim key : key = gFeatureKeys(idx)
+    Instr_ShowFeatureByKey key
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_ShowFeatureByKey(key)
+    If Not gInstructionMode Then Exit Sub
+
+    ' stop previous
+    gBlinkTimer.Enabled = False
+    gInstrSeqTimer.Enabled = False
+
+    ' clear PF baseline
+    Instr_AllInsertsOff
+    Instr_TurnOffGIActive
+    Instr_HideAllFlashers
+
+    ' GI for this feature
+    Instr_TurnOnGI key
+
+    ' Flashers (multiple) for this feature
+    If gFlashersByFeature.Exists(key) Then
+        Instr_ShowFlashers gFlashersByFeature(key)
+    End If
+
+    ' Sequence for this feature
+    If gSeqs.Exists(key) Then
+        gSeqSteps = gSeqs(key)
+        gSeqStepIdx = 0
+        Instr_ApplyStep gSeqSteps(gSeqStepIdx)
+    End If
+End Sub
+
+'========================
+'  GI control (arrays)
+'========================
+Sub Instr_TurnOnGI(key)
+    Dim arr, i, nm, L
+    gGIOn.RemoveAll
+    If gGIByFeature.Exists(key) Then
+        arr = gGIByFeature(key)
+        If IsArray(arr) Then
+            For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
+                nm = CStr(arr(i))
+                If TryGetLightByName(nm, L) Then
+                    If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+                        L.State = 1 : L.IntensityScale = 1
+                        If Not gGIOn.Exists(nm) Then Set gGIOn(nm) = L
+                    End If
+                End If
+            Next
+        End If
+    End If
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_TurnOffGIActive()
+    Dim v, L
+    For Each v In gGIOn.Items
+        Set L = v
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+            L.State = 0 : L.IntensityScale = 0
+        End If
+    Next
+    gGIOn.RemoveAll
+End Sub
+
+'========================
+'  Flasher control
+'========================
+Sub Instr_HideAllFlashers()
+
+    Dim v, F
+    For Each v In gActiveFlashers.Items
+        Set F = v
+        If TypeName(F) = "Flasher" Then F.Visible = False
+    Next
+    gActiveFlashers.RemoveAll
+End Sub
+
+Sub Instr_ShowFlashers(arr)
+    Dim i, nm, F
+    If IsArray(arr) Then
+        For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
+            nm = CStr(arr(i))
+            If TryGetFlasherByName(nm, F) Then
+                If TypeName(F) = "Flasher" Then
+                    F.Visible = True
+                    If Not gActiveFlashers.Exists(nm) Then Set gActiveFlashers(nm) = F
+                End If
+            End If
+        Next
+    End If
+End Sub

+Sub Instr_SetInsertsSolid(arr)
+    Dim i, nm, L
+    If IsArray(arr) Then
+        For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
+            nm = CStr(arr(i))
+            If TryGetLightByName(nm, L) Then

+            End If

+Sub Instr_SetBlinkGroup(arr)
+    Dim i, nm, L
+    If IsArray(arr) Then
+        For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
+            nm = CStr(arr(i))
+            If TryGetLightByName(nm, L) Then

+Sub gInstrSeqTimer_Timer()
+    gInstrSeqTimer.Enabled = False
+    If Not gInstructionMode Then Exit Sub
+    If IsArray(gSeqSteps) Then
+        gSeqStepIdx = (gSeqStepIdx + 1) Mod (UBound(gSeqSteps) + 1)
+'		Debug.print "----------------------------"
+'		Debug.print "Main:" & gSeqStepIdx
+'		Debug.print "----------------------------"
+        Instr_ApplyStep gSeqSteps(gSeqStepIdx)
+    End If
+End Sub
+
+Sub gBlinkTimer_Timer()
+    If Not gInstructionMode Then
+        gBlinkTimer.Enabled = False
+        Exit Sub
+    End If
+    gBlinkState = Not gBlinkState
+
+    Dim v, L
+    For Each v In gBlinkGroup.Items
+        Set L = v
+        If TypeName(L) = "Light" Then
+            If gBlinkState Then
+                L.State = 1 : L.IntensityScale = 1
+            Else
+                L.State = 0 : L.IntensityScale = 0
+            End If
+        End If
+    Next
+End Sub

+'========================
+'  Sequence engine
+'========================
+' Step = Array( holdMs, solidArr(), blinkArr() )
+Sub Instr_ApplyStep(stepArr)
+    Dim holdMs, solidArr, blinkArr
+
+    holdMs   = stepArr(0)
+    solidArr = stepArr(1)
+    blinkArr = stepArr(2)
+
+    ' Clear inserts (but leave GI as-is)
+    Instr_AllInsertsOff
+
+    ' Rebuild blink group
+    gBlinkGroup.RemoveAll
+
+    ' Solid ON
+    Call Instr_SetInsertsSolid(solidArr)
+
+    ' Blink group
+    Call Instr_SetBlinkGroup(blinkArr)
+
+    ' Start blink if needed
+    gBlinkState = True
+    gBlinkTimer.Enabled = (gBlinkGroup.Count > 0)
+
+    ' Arm next step
+    If IsNumeric(holdMs) And holdMs > 0 Then
+        gInstrSeqTimer.Interval = holdMs
+    Else
+        gInstrSeqTimer.Interval = 250
+    End If
+    gInstrSeqTimer.Enabled = True
+
+debug.print "SEQUENCE: " & gFeatureIndex
+		Select Case gFeatureIndex
+			Case 0
+
+			Case 1
+				Select Case gSeqStepIdx
+					Case 0
+						Debug.print "QDS: " & QuestDoor_State
+						if QuestDoor_State <> 1 Then QuestDoorOpen
+                        RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+				End Select
+			Case 2
+				if gSeqStepIdx = 0 Then
+					E1.Visible = True
+					E2.Visible = True
+					E3.Visible = True
+					E4.Visible = True
+                    RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+				End If
+
+			Case 3
+                 RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+			Case 4
+                 RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+					Select Case gSeqStepIdx
+						Case 0
+							InstrJackDT
+						Case 1
+							InstrJackDT
+						Case 2
+							InstrJackDT
+						Case 3
+							InstrJackDT
+						Case 4
+							DTRaise 1
+							DTRaise 2
+							DTRaise 3
+							DTRaise 4
+							'ReturnState
+						Case 5
+                         
+					End Select
+
+			Case 5
+				  RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+			Case 6
+				  RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+			Case 7
+				If MystCon = 0 AND gSeqStepIdx = 8 AND bInstMystery = False Then MysteryControllerOpen
+
+			Case 8
+				if gSeqStepIdx = 0 AND bashhitTrig.Enabled = False Then StartBashMode
+                RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+			Case 9
+                RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+
+				if gSeqStepIdx = 1 Then
+					RotateStorms_SuperSpinners
+					StartSpinnerLightning
+					ViewSpinner5
+				End If
+
+			Case 10
+				RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+
+			Case 11
+
+                RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+				Select Case gSeqStepIdx
+					Case 0
+						if Door006.Visible = False Then OpenDoor
+					Case 2
+						Target013.isdropped = 1
+						Playsound "Drop_Target_Down_1"
+					Case 4
+						Target012.isdropped = 1
+						Playsound "Drop_Target_Down_1"
+					Case 6
+						Target011.isdropped = 1
+						Playsound "Drop_Target_Down_1"
+					Case 8
+						Playsound "Drop_Target_Reset_1"
+						Target013.isdropped = 0
+						Target011.isdropped = 0
+						Target012.isdropped = 0
+				End Select			
+
+
+			Case 12
+				if gSeqStepIdx = 10 AND LockCon = 0 AND OrbitKicker.Enabled = False Then lockcontrolleropen
+
+			Case 13
+
+			Case 14
+                 RulesArrowTimer.Enabled = True
+				if RampDoor.Collidable Then rampdooropen "Instr"
+		End Select
+End Sub

+Function TryGetLightByName(nm, ByRef Lout)
+    ' Look in inserts and GI lookups
+    If gInsertLookup.Exists(nm) Then

+        TryGetLightByName = True
+        Exit Function
+    End If
+    If gGILookup.Exists(nm) Then

+        TryGetLightByName = True

+    End If
+    TryGetLightByName = False
+End Function

+Function TryGetFlasherByName(nm, ByRef Fout)
+    On Error Resume Next
+    Set Fout = Eval(nm)   ' evaluate the object by its name in VPX
+    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
+        Err.Clear
+        Set Fout = Nothing
+        TryGetFlasherByName = False
+    Else
+        TryGetFlasherByName = (TypeName(Fout) = "Flasher")
+    End If
+    On Error GoTo 0
+End Function

+
+Dim BarStep
+Dim BarPhase
+Dim LookCount
+Dim LookDir 
+
+Sub InitBar()
+	if nPCMod = 0 Then Exit Sub
+    BarStep = 1
+    BarPhase = 0
+    LookCount = 0
+    LookDir = 1
+    UpdateBar
+End Sub
+
+Sub BarTrig_Hit()
+    If BarPhase = 0 Then
+        BarPhase = 1
+        BarStep = 1
+        PlaySound "CW_Open"
+
+        BarTimer.Interval = 100
+        	if nPCMod > 0 Then BarTimer.Enabled = True
+    End If
+End Sub
+
+Sub BarTimer_Timer()
+
+    Select Case BarPhase
+
+        ' =================
+        ' OPEN
+        ' =================
+        Case 1
+            BarTimer.Interval = 100
+            BarStep = BarStep + 1
+
+            If BarStep >= 4 Then
+                BarStep = 5
+                BarPhase = 2
+                LookCount = 0
+                LookDir = 1
+            End If
+
+        ' =================
+        ' LOOK
+        ' =================
+        Case 2
+            BarTimer.Interval = 340
+
+            BarStep = BarStep + LookDir
+
+            ' Hit right side
+            If BarStep >= 8 Then
+                BarStep = 8
+                LookDir = -1
+                LookCount = LookCount + 1
+            End If
+
+            ' Hit left side
+            If BarStep <= 5 Then
+                BarStep = 5
+                LookDir = 1
+                LookCount = LookCount + 1
+            End If
+
+            ' 1 full left-right cycle
+            If LookCount >= 1 Then
+                PlaySound "CW_Close"
+
+                BarStep = 3
+                BarPhase = 3
+                BarTimer.Interval = 100
+            End If
+
+        ' =================
+        ' CLOSING
+        ' =================
+        Case 3
+            BarTimer.Interval = 100
+            BarStep = BarStep - 1
+
+            If BarStep <= 1 Then
+                BarStep = 1
+                BarPhase = 0
+                BarTimer.Enabled = False
+            End If
+
+    End Select
+
+    	if nPCMod > 0 Then UpdateBar
+End Sub
+

+	if nPCMod = 0 Then Exit Sub
+
+    bar001.Visible = (BarStep = 1)
+    bar002.Visible = (BarStep = 2)
+    bar003.Visible = (BarStep = 3)

+    bar005.Visible = (BarStep = 5)
+    bar006.Visible = (BarStep = 6)
+    bar007.Visible = (BarStep = 7)
+    bar008.Visible = (BarStep = 8)
+
+End Sub

+
+Sub InitSKFlashers()
+
+    sk001.Visible = False

+
+End Sub
+
+
+Sub StartSKFlashers()
+    If skRunning Then Exit Sub
+
+    skFrame = 1
+    skTimeElapsed = 0
+    skRunning = True
+    skFrameStep = 0
+
+    EyeLevel = 0
+    EyeDir = 1
+    EyeState = 0
+    LastEyeLevel = -1
+
+    sk001.Visible = True
+    sk002.Visible = True
+
+    skeye1.IntensityScale = 0
+    skeye2.IntensityScale = 0
+    skeye3.IntensityScale = 0
+    skeye4.IntensityScale = 0
+
+    skeye1.Visible = True
+    skeye2.Visible = True
+    skeye3.Visible = True
+    skeye4.Visible = True
+
+    flasherbloomgracie.Visible = True
+    flasherbloomgracie.IntensityScale = 0
+
+    gracielight.Visible = True
+
+    SKTimer.Enabled = True
+End Sub
+
+
+Sub SKTimer_Timer()
+
+    If Not skRunning Then Exit Sub
+
+    ' ***************************************************
+    If skTimeElapsed >= 60000 Then
+        skRunning = False
+        SKTimer.Enabled = False
+
+        sk001.Visible = False
+        sk002.Visible = False
+        skeye1.Visible = False
+        skeye2.Visible = False
+        skeye3.Visible = False
+        skeye4.Visible = False
+        flasherbloomgracie.Visible = False
+        gracielight.Visible = False
+        Exit Sub
+    End If
+    ' ***************************************************
+
+    Dim img
+    img = "bfl_" & skFrame
+
+    sk001.ImageA = img
+    sk002.ImageA = img
+
+    skFrameStep = skFrameStep + 1
+    If skFrameStep >= 2 Then
+        skFrame = skFrame + 1
+        skFrameStep = 0
+    End If
+
+    If skFrame > 48 Then skFrame = 1
+
+    Select Case EyeState
+
+        Case 0
+            EyeLevel = EyeLevel + 0.05
+            If EyeLevel >= 1 Then
+                EyeLevel = 1
+                EyeState = 1
+            End If
+
+        Case 1
+            EyeLevel = EyeLevel + (EyeDir * 0.05)
+
+            If EyeLevel >= 1 Then
+                EyeLevel = 1
+                EyeDir = -1
+            ElseIf EyeLevel <= 0.4 Then
+                EyeLevel = 0.4
+                EyeDir = 1
+            End If
+
+            If skTimeElapsed >= 60000 Then EyeState = 2
+
+        Case 2
+            EyeLevel = EyeLevel - 0.05
+            If EyeLevel <= 0 Then EyeLevel = 0
+
+    End Select
+
+    If EyeLevel <> LastEyeLevel Then
+        skeye1.IntensityScale = EyeLevel
+        skeye2.IntensityScale = EyeLevel
+        skeye3.IntensityScale = EyeLevel
+        skeye4.IntensityScale = EyeLevel
+        flasherbloomgracie.IntensityScale = EyeLevel
+        LastEyeLevel = EyeLevel
+    End If
+
+'    ' Gracie blink: normal first 30s, faster last 30s
+    If skTimeElapsed < 45000 Then
+        If (skTimeElapsed Mod 400) < SKTimer.Interval Then
+            gracielight.Visible = Not gracielight.Visible
+        End If
+    Else
+        If (skTimeElapsed Mod 200) < SKTimer.Interval Then
+            gracielight.Visible = Not gracielight.Visible
+        End If
+    End If
+
+    skTimeElapsed = skTimeElapsed + SKTimer.Interval
+
+End Sub

+    skeye3.Visible = False

+    flasherbloomgracie.Visible = False
+    gracielight.Visible = False

+Dim SpeakerAngle, SpeakerCycleSpeed, SineValue
+Dim FadeLvl, FadeDir, PendingColor
+
+Const SPD_Normal = 0.016   ' Slow relaxed pulse during idle
+Const SPD_Mode   = 0.048   ' Faster urgent pulse during missions
+
+Dim SC_Idle
+Dim SC_Egg
+Dim SC_Miao

+SC_Egg			= RGB(180, 0, 255)
+SC_Miao			= RGB(0, 200, 80)
+SC_Rain			= RGB(128, 16, 0)

+SC_Pillars		= RGB(255,165,0)
+SC_Chaos		= RGB(220,50,0)
+SC_Wing			= RGB(160,0,30)
+SC_Kidnap		= RGB(40,80,180)
+SC_Tiger		= RGB(160, 0, 220)
+SC_Rescue		= RGB(255,40,120)
+
+SpeakerAngle       = 0
+SpeakerCycleSpeed  = SPD_Normal
+FadeLvl            = 0
+
+Sub InitSpeakerColor()
+    PendingColor             = SC_Idle
+    VRCab_Glow.Color         = SC_Idle
+    VRCab_Glow.Opacity       = 0
+	SpeakerCycleSpeed        = SPD_Normal
+    FadeLvl                  = 0
+    FadeDir                  = "Out"
+    SpeakerFadeTimer.Enabled = True
+	VRSpeakerTimer.Enabled   = False
+End Sub
+
+Sub SpeakerMissionStart(missionColor)
+    PendingColor             = missionColor
+    SpeakerCycleSpeed        = SPD_Mode
+    FadeLvl                  = VRCab_Glow.Opacity / 2400
+    FadeDir                  = "Out"
+    SpeakerFadeTimer.Enabled = True
+    VRSpeakerTimer.Enabled   = False
+End Sub
+
+Sub SpeakerMissionEnd()
+    PendingColor             = SC_Idle
+    SpeakerCycleSpeed        = SPD_Normal
+    FadeLvl                  = VRCab_Glow.Opacity / 2400
+    FadeDir                  = "Out"
+    SpeakerFadeTimer.Enabled = True
+    VRSpeakerTimer.Enabled   = False
+End Sub
+
+Sub VRSpeakerTimer_Timer()
+    SpeakerAngle = SpeakerAngle + SpeakerCycleSpeed
+    If SpeakerAngle > 2 * PI Then SpeakerAngle = SpeakerAngle - (2 * PI)
+    SineValue          = (Sin(SpeakerAngle) + 1) / 2
+    VRCab_Glow.Opacity = SineValue * 2400
+End Sub
+
+Sub SpeakerFadeTimer_Timer()
+    If FadeDir = "Out" Then
+        FadeLvl = FadeLvl - 0.05
+        If FadeLvl <= 0 Then
+            FadeLvl                  = 0
+            VRCab_Glow.Opacity       = 0
+            VRCab_Glow.Color         = PendingColor
+            SpeakerFadeTimer.Enabled = False
+            SpeakerAngle             = (3 * PI) / 2  ' Natural zero of sine â€” rises smoothly from here
+            VRSpeakerTimer.Enabled   = True
+        Else
+            VRCab_Glow.Opacity = FadeLvl * 2400
+        End If
+    End If
+End Sub
